SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 什么呀宥万，你怎么知道的？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 什麼啊，宥萬，你怎麼會知道？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: えっ ユマンさん どうしてわかったの？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O quê? Como você sabe disso, Yumán?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah~ You’ve got that cat photo in your office, remember?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 啊~你房间不是有猫咪的照片嘛！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊～ 您房間裡不是有貓咪的照片嗎！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ〜課長の部屋に猫の写真ありますよね！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ah~ Kamu kan punya foto kucing di kantor, inget nggak?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah~ é que tem fotos de gatos no seu quarto.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah~ Es que tiene fotos de gatos en su cuarto.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه~ تو اون عکس گربه را در دفترت داری، یادت هست؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What?! When did you even see that?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 什么呀~那又是什么时候看到的？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 什麼啊～你又是什麼時候看到的？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: え、なにそれ いつ見たの！？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Apa?! Emang kapan kamu liat itu?!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O quê~? E quando você viu isso?

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 지금 그란 님이 잠자고 그런 방 말하는 거예요?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Are we talking about the room Miss Gran sleeps in?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 他现在说的是你睡觉的房间吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 他現在說的是您睡覺的房間嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 今 グランさんが寝たりしてる部屋のことですか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kita lagi ngomongin ruangannya Miss Gran tidur, ya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tá falando do lugar onde a chefe Gran dorme?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Está hablando del dónde la jefa Gran duerme?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ما در مورد اتاقی صحبت می کنیم که خانم گرن در اون می خوابد؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Wait, are you two... living together or something?!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ま、まさか二人 一緒に住んでるんですか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tunggu, kalian tuh… tinggal bareng atau gimana?!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não me diga que vocês… moram juntos?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No me digas que ustedes… ¿viven juntos?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: صبر کن شما دوتا... با هم زندگی می کنید یا چیزی؟!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 가, 같이 살다뇨! 그게 무슨 소리예요!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: L-Living together?! What are you even talking about?!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 同、同居什么呀！这什么话！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 同、同居什麼的！那是什麼話！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: い、一緒に住むって なんですか！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: T-tinggal bareng?! Kamu ngomong apa sih?!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: M-morar juntos!? O que você tá dizendo?!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ال-زندگی مشترک؟! اصلا از چی حرف میزنی؟!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 우선 씨 무슨 그런 농담을 해!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Woo-seon, why would you joke like that?!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 优先你怎么开这种玩笑！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 宇善你怎麼開這種玩笑啦！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ウソンさん、そんな冗談言わないでよ！
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Wooseon, como pode brincar com uma coisa dessas?!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아니, 아까 전에 분명 이거 방이라고 말씀하셨잖아요!!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: But just now, you clearly said “room,” didn’t you?!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不是，刚才明明说的是“房间”啊！！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不是，剛才明明說了是房間不是嗎！！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: でもさっき確かに部屋って言ってましたよ！！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi barusan kamu jelas-jelas bilang “ruangan,” kan?!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Pero si acaba de decir en su "cuarto".
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اما همین الان به وضوح گفتی «اتاق»، نه؟!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah—right!! Desk! That’s what you meant!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ、あっ！！そう！席！席ですよ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ah—iya!! Meja! Maksud kamu itu, kan!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, ah!! Isso, isso~ escritório, claro!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه - درسته!! میز تحریر! منظورت همین بود!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Over there, the desk in her office.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 他說的辦公室的座位啦
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ほら あのオフィスの せ・き
じゃあ僕が聞き間違えたんですね
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: پس باید اون موقع اشتباه شنیده باشم.

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: そうそう そうなんですよ〜
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nah, iya~ cuma salah paham doang~
